recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It removes an active-page contradiction with the FHIR-34434 resolution without broadening the change or creating redundant wording elsewhere.
issue_request: FHIR-34434 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked FHIR-I to clarify duplicate ElementDefinition mappings, with a warning invariant for duplicate mapping identities and guidance that a profile mapping with the same identity replaces the corresponding parent mapping.
initial_application: The warning invariant already exists in source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml as a warning on ElementDefinition using mapping.select(identity).isDistinct(). The explicit FHIR-34434 source commit d94012a93904193b692562a5f43a08b3e0327934 added the profiling-page replacement rule in source/profiling.html. The active ElementDefinition narrative note in source/elementdefinition.html still said mappings do not replace base mappings, so the application was incomplete across active pages.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ElementDefinition as an active normative datatype. FHIR-I minutes from 2022-04-04 record the duplicate-mapping question and 11-0-0 Persuasive with Modification vote, and the linked Zulip thread shows the motivating US Core duplicate servd mapping example. A related Jira search found only FHIR-34434.
reconciliation: Updated source/elementdefinition.html so the delta-marker note keeps additional constraints additive but states that an additional mapping with the same identity replaces the base mapping with that identity. The existing invariant and profiling text were left unchanged.
source_changes: source/elementdefinition.html: clarified the delta-marker note so mappings with the same identity replace the corresponding base mapping while additional constraints remain additive.
